themes.counterRead: Two caveats keep this from being a blanket buy-the-dip read. First, the engine's 'sentiment-driven' label is a trailing-revenue template — it auto-labels price-down/revenue-up as sentiment disconnect and cannot see guidance trajectory or sequential deceleration, which is where growth-story collapses show up first. Treat the labels on the deepest drawdowns (APP -61.9%, TTD -78.5%) as unverified until the next earnings print, not as vetted sentiment gaps. Second, TTD was removed from the S&P 500 on Sep 21 with guided revenue decline — that is a real business signal, not sentiment, so it belongs in a different bucket than NOW.
